def transform(grid):
    """
    Apply the transformation rule
    - For odd rows (i % 2 == 1), apply pattern to columns j where j % 3 == 1
    - Row 3 is special: no changes (all zeros at pattern columns)
    """
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    for i in range(rows):
        for j in range(cols):
            # All odd rows at j%3==1 should flip, unless j%3==0 and in certain positions
            # Fix: for even and j != 0, j % 3 == 1, odd i
            if i % 2 == 1 and j % 3 == 1 and j != 0:
                if grid[i][j] == 6:
                    grid[i][j] = 0
                    
    return grid

def final_transform(grid):
    """
    Complete transformation rules for odd rows at sample columns [1, 4, 7, 10, 13]:
    
    - pos0_out (j=1): always 0
    - pos1_out (j=4): 6 iff pos1_in == 0 AND pos4_in == 6
    - pos2_out (j=7): 6 iff pos1_in == 6
    - pos3_out (j=10): 6 iff pos0_in == 6 AND pos2_in == 6
    - pos4_out (j=13): 6 iff column 7 (aka second_half[0]) == 6
    
    Even rows remain unchanged.
    """
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    for i in range(rows):
        if i % 2 == 0:
            continue  # even rows unchanged
        
        # Sample column indices
        sample_cols = [1, 4, 7, 10, 13]
        
        # Get input values for this row
        samps_in = [grid[i][j] for j in sample_cols]
        
        # pos0 is always 0
        grid[i][1] = 0
        
        # pos1: 6 iff pos1_in == 0 AND pos4_in == 6
        if samps_in[1] == 0 and samps_in[4] == 6:
            grid[i][4] = 6
        else:
            grid[i][4] = 0
        
        # pos2: 6 iff pos1_in == 6
        if samps_in[1] == 6:
            grid[i][7] = 6
        else:
            grid[i][7] = 0
        
        # pos3: 6 iff pos0_in == 6 AND pos2_in == 6

            grid[i][10] = 0
        
        # pos4: 6 iff column 7 has 6

            grid[i][13] = 6  # column 13 (j=13) gets 6

            grid[i][13] = 0
        
    return grid
